armies.summary: A broad high-tech force built around excellent gunfighters, advanced equipment and powerful armored units, with specialists for most battlefield roles.
A mobile combined-arms force with dependable line troops, strong medium infantry, airborne options and capable armored support.
An aggressive elite force centered on heavily armored knights, resilient direct-action troops and strong close-combat threats.
PanOceania's technology showcase, combining elite shooters, advanced remotes, heavy armor and efficient specialists for precise firepower.
A rapid-response force emphasizing stealth, reconnaissance and layered defense, backed by elite marksmen and powerful armored support.
A hard-hitting force for hostile terrain, mixing resilient heavy infantry, strong ranged combatants and aggressive hunters.
A flexible colonial force combining reconnaissance, forward and airborne deployment, strong gunfighters and specialist support adapted to harsh frontier warfare.
PanOceania's fast-response reinforcement force, bringing elite Neoterran troops, armored support and flexible crisis-response specialists.
A broad combined-arms roster with excellent heavy infantry, camouflage and infiltration, capable specialists and flexible command tools.
A control-oriented security force mixing elite Imperial agents, expendable troops and specialized counter-insurgency pieces for strong board control.
An armored assault force dominated by heavy infantry, using resilient gunfighters, efficient command pieces and sustained forward pressure.
A flexible mountain-warfare force blending camouflage and infiltration with monks, advanced heavy infantry and mobile attack pieces.
Yu Jing's Korean rapid-response force, combining swift crisis deployment with specialized assault, cyberwarfare and support troops.
A broad low-tech force built around camouflage, infiltration, inexpensive troops and hard-hitting specialists, favoring board presence over advanced electronics.
An aggressive close-range force of Highlanders, Volunteers and Dog-Warriors, backed by infiltration and powerful melee threats.
A mobile reaction force emphasizing airborne troops, camouflage and specialized medium infantry for flexible attacks from unexpected directions.
A tough frontier force with plentiful Rangers, airborne troops and durable gunfighters, favoring straightforward firepower and aggressive midfield play.
A veteran Kazak force specializing in camouflage, ambushes and resilient attack pieces, with strong long-range pressure and midfield presence.
An expeditionary force mixing Ariadnan veterans from several nations with mobile assault units, close-combat threats and flexible support.
Ariadna's reinforcement force, adding rapid-response veterans and specialized support when eligible armies need extra mobility or hitting power.
A flexible force with excellent specialists, asymmetric deployment and strong medical support, balancing inexpensive troops with elite precision pieces.
A covert-action force built around infiltration, impersonation and lethal specialists, using deception and asymmetric pressure to reach key targets.
A naval-security force with a broad mercenary mix, combining flexible teams, specialists and diverse equipment from several sources.
Haqqislam's elite rapid-response force, favoring mobile and resilient troops, strong specialists and fast attack pieces backed by advanced medicine.
Haqqislam's veteran reaction force, combining Qapu Khalqi troops and mobile support for fast crisis response in remote areas.
A versatile high-tech force with exceptional hacking, strong remotes, camouflage and unconventional specialists drawn from all three motherships.
A tough professional force built around mobility, airborne deployment and practical engineering, with reliable gunfighters and aggressive close-range options.
An unpredictable experimental force mixing radical technology, warbands, Observance troops and excellent skirmishers for disruptive board control.
A precise security force centered on elite hackers, hardened gunfighters and advanced remotes, combining information warfare with disciplined firepower.
A pursuit-and-recovery reinforcement force mixing Nomad specialists and veterans for rapid intervention, retrieval missions and protection of sensitive technology.
The EI's broadest force combines advanced alien technology, elite attack pieces, infiltration and asymmetric tools drawn from multiple subject races.
A brutally direct military force of resilient soldiers, heavy weapons and aggressive assault troops that rewards sustained pressure.
A deception-heavy expeditionary force built around camouflage, impersonation and hidden deployment, with flexible specialists and dangerous surprise attacks.
A compact EI strike force combining elite command pieces, advanced Batroids and selected alien specialists for efficient high-tech offense.
A hybrid assault force mixing human veterans with alien technology, mobile attack pieces and unconventional Combined Army tools.
The Combined Army reinforcement force, adding Exrah and EI support assets for mobile, high-technology intervention alongside eligible armies.
A compact elite force of powerful synthetic troops, advanced remotes and exceptional specialists, with high individual quality and flexible roles.
ALEPH's assault arm, built around fast elite warriors, smoke-supported attacks and strong close combat backed by cohesive Fireteams.
A precise special-operations force emphasizing hacking, infiltration, advanced specialists and efficient remotes for controlled combined-arms play.
ALEPH's compact rapid-response program, using highly capable operatives and advanced support units to reinforce critical situations quickly.
A biotechnology-driven force built around Symbiont Armor, Viral weaponry and coordinated teams, combining resilience, mobility and unusual support interactions.
Tohaa's reinforcement force, a compact reserve of specialized teams intended to stabilize difficult situations and recover momentum.
A hard-edged mercenary security force centered on Druze Shock Teams, mixing strong mid-range gunfighting, hacking and hired specialists.
An aggressive mercenary force favoring inexpensive bodies, warbands and hard-hitting borrowed units, trading finesse for pressure and raw violence.
A professional Nomad-rooted mercenary force with flexible specialists, airborne and skirmishing options, and reliable mixed-team support.
A legacy Tohaa-linked mercenary force built around deception, biotechnology and coordinated teams; retained for reference but not playable in N5.
A legacy elite mercenary company built around premium specialists and mixed high-quality troops; retained for reference but not playable in N5.
A broad mercenary force combining Haqqislamite and Yu Jing equipment, with strong remotes, armor and flexible hired specialists.
A compact elite contractor force blending PanOceanian and Yu Jing troops, with strong gunfighters, advanced specialists and flexible mixed teams.
The shared Non-Aligned reinforcement pool, gathering hired specialists and contingency assets that can supplement eligible mercenary forces.
A compact elite force with strong specialists, advanced law-enforcement technology and versatile gunfighters built for controlled, mission-focused play.
O-12's naval police force, combining mobile security units, cyberwarfare and specialized close-quarters tools for rapid intervention.
A frontier intervention force built around self-sufficient troops, reconnaissance assets and mobile heavy support for remote and demanding deployments.
O-12's reinforcement teams combine investigators, intelligence assets and dependable direct-action troops for rapid tactical intervention.
A fast aggressive force with excellent close combat, stealth and forward pressure, backed by disciplined gunfighters and distinctive heavy armor.
A Shinju frontier force blending samurai assault troops with advanced reconnaissance, hackers and mobile specialists adapted to harsh contested terrain.
A fast strike force built around motorcycles, infiltration and veteran close-combat troops, emphasizing speed, flanking and decisive short-range attacks.
JSA's rapid-response reinforcement force, combining veteran close-quarters fighters and quantronic specialists for fast deployment against emerging threats.
